description: NSW Coastal Erosion - 2025 is a dataset listed in NSW Government open data portal (data.nsw.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by NSW Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water. This dataset provides regional-scale mapping of coastal erosion hazards for the New South Wales (NSW) coastline. Coverage: New South Wales. The portal files it under the publisher NSW Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water. Its tags are Coastal Erosion, Coastal Management, Coastal Shoreline, Marine Hazards, Water Wetlands and Coastal. It offers 4 resource(s) in pdf, txt, zip. The portal shows 2026-06-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-nsw.
